name: WinFsp
purpose: User-mode file system driver for streaming drive redirection (docs/drive-redirection.md, WinFsp backend); the Host setup installs its core feature
license: GPL-3.0 with the FLOSS exception (permission to link the platform WinFsp DLL and to distribute the unmodified project installer)
copyrightNotice: WinFsp - Windows File System Proxy, Copyright (C) Bill Zissimopoulos

msi.name: winfsp-2.1.25156.msi
msi.features: F.Main/F.User ('Core', install level 1: default); F.Developer, F.KernelDeveloper, F.Cygfuse are level 1000 (off unless INSTALLLEVEL is raised)

signature.how: Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the downloaded MSI and, after msiexec /a (administrative extract, nothing installed or run), on the driver and DLLs inside

msi.issuer: DigiCert Global G3 Code Signing ECC SHA384 2021 CA1
msi.timestamp: DigiCert Timestamp 2024 (the signing certificate expired 2025-07-03; the timestamp keeps the signature valid)

driver.issuer: Microsoft Windows Third Party Component CA 2014
driver.note: Microsoft attestation signing; certificate expired 2025-10-09, the timestamp keeps it valid

notes: The MSI is never edited, repackaged or re-signed and is not stored in this repository (large binary, same convention as usbip-win2/UsbDk): tools/fetch-winfsp.ps1 downloads it into .tools/winfsp and checks the SHA-256 and the Authenticode signature; the Host package carries it as bin/winfsp/.

Only the SDK headers winfsp.h and fsctl.h are vendored (GPLv3 + FLOSS exception). The Host does not link winfsp-x64.lib: it loads winfsp-x64.dll with FspLoad (registry InstallDir) and resolves the few exports it needs with GetProcAddress, so a Host without WinFsp starts and falls back to WebDAV.

FLOSS-exception conditions met: AGPL-3.0 project (free software), unmodified installer, notice 'WinFsp - Windows File System Proxy, Copyright (C) Bill Zissimopoulos' with the repository link in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, the Host setup text and docs/drive-redirection.md.
Source offer: the WinFsp source is at https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp (tag v2.1). The Multitap Host source is offered like the x264 obligation (README of the Host package).
The MSI installs the WinFsp.Launcher service and the WinFsp driver service; the Host setup runs msiexec with the default (Core) feature set only.
